label: Дом
description: The noun дом (house, home, building) through its full case ladder, plus the frozen adverbs дома (at home) and домой (homeward).

missions.phrase: Это мой дом и моя семья.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 1. 'Дом' here is the nominative singular, the dictionary form, naming the thing. 2. 'Мой' agrees with the masculine noun. 3. A natural everyday sentence introducing the word.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 1. 'Дом' is the direct object of 'вижу'. 2. For inanimate masculine nouns the accusative matches the nominative form. 3. A clear example of the object role in a real scene.

Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 1. 'Около' governs the genitive case. 2. 'Дома' is the genitive singular of дом, marking location near. 3. A natural sentence describing walking near the building.

Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 1. 'Из' takes the genitive 'дома' to mark motion out of. 2. 'Вышел' is the past-tense verb of exiting. 3. A natural motion-from-source scene anchored in the morning.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 1. 'К' governs the dative case. 2. 'Дому' is the dative singular, marking motion toward a goal. 3. A complete sentence pairing movement with a destination.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 1. 'Доволен' takes the instrumental case. 2. 'Домом' is the instrumental singular of дом. 3. 'Своим' agrees in case and gender with the noun.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of place. 1. 'За' with the instrumental 'домом' means behind. 2. 'Сад' names what lies there. 3. A complete spatial-scene sentence describing the garden.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 1. 'В' with the prepositional 'доме' means inside. 2. 'Тепло' is an impersonal predicate. 3. A natural description of the warm interior in winter.

Strategic focus: Prepositional of topic. 1. 'О' governs the prepositional 'доме' to mean about. 2. 'Говорят' is the third-person plural verb. 3. The house is the subject of the neighbours' discussion.
Strategic focus: Frozen adverb дома. 1. 'Дома' is a frozen adverbial form meaning 'at home', not a case of дом. 2. It marks static location. 3. 'Сегодня' and 'весь день' anchor it in time.
Strategic focus: Frozen adverb домой. 1. 'Домой' is a frozen adverb meaning 'homeward', expressing motion toward home. 2. It is never declined. 3. Contrast it with static 'дома' (at home).
Strategic focus: Motion adverb домой. 1. 'Пора' is an impersonal 'it is time'. 2. 'Домой' keeps its frozen directional meaning, 'homeward'. 3. A very common everyday phrase for leaving.
Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Большой' and 'новый' both agree with masculine nominative 'дом'. 2. Two adjectives stack before the noun. 3. A natural descriptive sentence about their home.

missions.phrase: Теперь мы живём в новом доме.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adjective in prepositional. 1. 'В доме' sets location inside. 2. 'Новом' is the prepositional masculine form of новый, agreeing with 'доме'. 3. Shows adjective declension in a lived context.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural дома́. 1. 'Дома́' is the stressed-ending nominative plural of дом, homographic with adverb 'дома' (at home) — distinguished only by stress. 2. 'Старые' agrees. 3. Watch the stress.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural домо́в. 1. 'Много' governs the genitive plural 'домо́в'. 2. The -ов ending marks the masculine plural here. 3. 'Вокруг' frames the scene all around.
Strategic focus: Plural subject дома́. 1. 'Дома́' is the nominative plural subject, stressed on the ending and homographic with adverb 'дома'. 2. 'Стоят' agrees in the plural. 3. 'Новые' agrees too.

Strategic focus: Genitive scene with adjective. 1. 'Около' governs the genitive 'дома'. 2. 'Большого' is the genitive masculine form of большой, agreeing with the noun. 3. A full descriptive location sentence.
